title: Provider Manifest
description: Machine-readable description of an Africa Local provider plugin. Every directory under providers/**/ (except _template) must contain a provider.yaml that validates against this schema.

category.description: The service category this provider emulates. Africa Local starts with mobile-money; other categories are reserved for future services.

version.description: Semantic version of this provider plugin, independent of the Africa Local runtime version.

status.description: Maturity of the provider. See specs/service-contract.md for the meaning of each value.

description.description: Short summary of the provider and any notable approximations vs. the real service.

protocol.description: Transport protocol the provider exposes. Only http is supported in v0.1.

basePath.description: Path prefix this provider is mounted under on the single Africa Local runtime (see ARCHITECTURE.md - one runtime, path-routed).

scenarios.description: Scenario names this provider declares support for. Each name must correspond to a scenarios/<name>.yaml file.

maintainers.description: Optional list of maintainer handles or emails for this specific provider directory.

approximations.description: Explicit, honest list of ways this emulator differs from the real provider (favor transparent approximation over false fidelity, per ARCHITECTURE.md).
